examples.en: Small businesses flourish when the local economy is strong.
examples.zh: 當地經濟強健時，小型企業便會興盛。

examples.en: These plants flourish in warm and sunny places.
examples.zh: 這些植物在溫暖又陽光充足的地方長得很茂盛。

examples.en: Her talent began to flourish after she joined the art club.
examples.zh: 她加入美術社之後，才華開始綻放。

examples.en: He studied all night because he did not want to flunk the exam.
examples.zh: 他熬夜讀書，因為他不想考試不及格。

examples.en: Many students flunk this course in their first year.
examples.zh: 許多學生第一年就把這門課當掉。

examples.en: If you flunk the quiz, you can try again next week.
examples.zh: 如果小考不及格，你下週可以再考一次。

examples.en: The two teams were friendly rivals, not foes.
examples.zh: 這兩支球隊是友好的對手，不是敵人。

examples.en: In the story, the hero must face a powerful foe.
examples.zh: 故事裡，英雄必須面對一個強大的敵人。

examples.en: Lack of sleep is a foe of good health.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足是健康的大敵。

examples.en: Our teacher told us a story from Taiwanese folklore.
examples.zh: 老師告訴我們一則台灣民間傳說的故事。

examples.en: The museum has a special exhibit on local folklore.
examples.zh: 博物館有一場關於在地民俗的特展。

examples.en: Many festivals are rooted in folklore passed down for centuries.
examples.zh: 許多節慶源自流傳了數百年的民間傳說。

senses.zh: 難對付的；強大的；令人敬畏的

examples.en: Our team faced a formidable opponent in the final game.
examples.zh: 我們的球隊在決賽中面對一個強勁的對手。

examples.en: Learning a new language can be a formidable task.
examples.zh: 學習一種新語言可能是一項艱鉅的任務。

examples.en: The manager has a formidable reputation in the industry.
examples.zh: 這位經理在業界享有令人敬畏的名聲。

senses.zh: 制定；構思；有系統地表達

examples.en: The committee will formulate a new plan next month.
examples.zh: 委員會下個月將制定一項新計畫。

examples.en: She took a moment to formulate her answer.
examples.zh: 她花了一點時間組織自己的答案。

examples.en: Scientists formulate a theory based on careful observation.
examples.zh: 科學家根據仔細的觀察來建立理論。

examples.en: He promised never to forsake his old friends.
examples.zh: 他保證絕不拋棄老朋友。

examples.en: She had to forsake her hobbies to focus on her studies.
examples.zh: 她必須放棄興趣，專心讀書。

examples.en: Some people forsake city life for a quiet village.
examples.zh: 有些人捨棄都市生活，改過寧靜的鄉村生活。

senses.zh: 即將到來的；即將出版的；樂意提供的

examples.en: Please check the poster for our forthcoming school events.
examples.zh: 請看海報了解我們即將舉辦的校內活動。

examples.en: The author's forthcoming book will be out in May.
examples.zh: 這位作者即將出版的新書將在五月問世。

examples.en: The company was not forthcoming about its plans.
examples.zh: 公司對於自己的計畫並不願意透露。

examples.en: The town built a high wall to fortify itself against floods.
examples.zh: 這座城鎮築起高牆，以強化防洪能力。

examples.en: Eating well can fortify your body against colds.
examples.zh: 吃得健康可以增強你身體對感冒的抵抗力。

examples.en: This cereal is fortified with extra vitamins and iron.
examples.zh: 這種麥片添加了額外的維生素和鐵質。

examples.en: The farmer keeps fowl such as ducks and geese.
examples.zh: 農夫飼養鴨和鵝之類的家禽。

examples.en: Roast fowl is a traditional dish at the festival.
examples.zh: 烤禽肉是這個節慶的傳統菜餚。

examples.en: Wild fowl gather by the lake every autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，野生禽鳥都會聚集在湖邊。

examples.en: He suffered a fracture in his left arm during the game.
examples.zh: 他在比賽中左手臂骨折了。

examples.en: The doctor said the fracture would heal in six weeks.
examples.zh: 醫生說這處骨折六週內會痊癒。

examples.en: There is a small fracture in the old pipe.
examples.zh: 這根舊水管上有一道小裂縫。

examples.en: She fell and fractured her wrist while skating.
examples.zh: 她溜冰時跌倒，摔斷了手腕。

examples.en: The strong wind fractured a branch of the old tree.
examples.zh: 強風折斷了老樹的一根樹枝。

examples.en: The ice may fracture if too many people walk on it.
examples.zh: 如果太多人在冰上行走，冰面可能會碎裂。

examples.en: The garden is full of fragrant flowers in spring.
examples.zh: 春天時，花園裡滿是芬芳的花朵。

examples.en: She made a cup of fragrant tea for her guests.
examples.zh: 她為客人泡了一杯香氣四溢的茶。

examples.en: A fragrant smell came from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房飄出一股香味。

senses.zh: 瘋狂的；慌亂的；焦急萬分的

examples.en: He made a frantic call to his mother after missing the bus.
examples.zh: 他錯過公車後，慌張地打電話給媽媽。

examples.en: The office was frantic on the day of the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止當天，辦公室一片忙亂。

examples.en: We made a frantic search for the lost keys.
examples.zh: 我們瘋狂地尋找遺失的鑰匙。

examples.en: My brother is a computer freak and plays games all weekend.
examples.zh: 我哥哥是個電腦迷，整個週末都在玩遊戲。

examples.en: A freak storm closed the airport for two days.
examples.zh: 一場罕見的暴風雨使機場關閉了兩天。

examples.en: Don't call him a freak just because he dresses differently.
examples.zh: 別只因為他穿著不同就叫他怪人。

examples.en: I freak out whenever I see a big spider.
examples.zh: 我一看到大蜘蛛就嚇壞了。

examples.en: Don't freak when you see the test results.
examples.zh: 看到成績時別抓狂。

examples.en: The loud noise made the little dog freak.
examples.zh: 巨大的聲響讓小狗驚慌失措。

examples.en: Rubbing your hands together creates friction and heat.
examples.zh: 兩手互搓會產生摩擦和熱。

examples.en: Rubber soles increase friction between the shoe and the floor.
examples.zh: 橡膠鞋底增加了鞋子與地板之間的摩擦力。

examples.en: There was some friction between the two roommates.
examples.zh: 那兩位室友之間有一些摩擦。

examples.en: The fumes from the factory made the air hard to breathe.
examples.zh: 工廠排出的廢氣讓空氣難以呼吸。

examples.en: Open the window to let the paint fumes out.
examples.zh: 打開窗戶，讓油漆的氣味散出去。

examples.en: Car fumes are a major cause of air pollution.
examples.zh: 汽車廢氣是空氣汙染的主要原因。

examples.en: He fumed quietly when the train was delayed again.
examples.zh: 火車又誤點時，他悶不吭聲地生著氣。

examples.en: She fumed over the rude email from her customer.
examples.zh: 她對客戶那封無禮的電子郵件感到憤怒。

examples.en: The chemicals began to fume when they were mixed.
examples.zh: 這些化學藥品混合後開始冒煙。

examples.en: She could not hide her fury when she saw the broken window.
examples.zh: 看到破掉的窗戶時，她無法掩飾自己的怒氣。

examples.en: The fury of the storm surprised everyone in the town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨的猛烈讓鎮上每個人都很吃驚。

examples.en: His face turned red with fury.
examples.zh: 他氣得滿臉通紅。

examples.en: The fuse blew, so all the lights went out.
examples.zh: 保險絲燒斷了，所以所有的燈都熄了。

examples.en: Dad replaced the fuse in the old radio.
examples.zh: 爸爸換掉了那台舊收音機裡的保險絲。

examples.en: Always check the fuse before you use the heater.
examples.zh: 使用暖爐前，務必先檢查保險絲。

examples.en: Heat can fuse two pieces of metal together.
examples.zh: 高溫可以把兩片金屬熔接在一起。

examples.en: The band tries to fuse rock and traditional music.
examples.zh: 這個樂團嘗試把搖滾與傳統音樂融合在一起。

examples.en: The two small companies will fuse into one next year.
examples.zh: 這兩家小公司明年將合併為一家。

senses.zh: 大驚小怪；小題大作；吵鬧

examples.en: Don't make a fuss about such a small mistake.
examples.zh: 別為了這麼小的錯誤大驚小怪。

examples.en: There was a lot of fuss over the new school rules.
examples.zh: 新校規引起了許多爭議。

examples.en: The baby cried without any fuss at the doctor's office.
examples.zh: 寶寶在診所裡一點也沒有吵鬧。

examples.en: Mom always fusses over us when we are sick.
examples.zh: 我們生病時，媽媽總是特別操心。

examples.en: Stop fussing about your hair and get in the car.
examples.zh: 別再為頭髮煩惱了，快上車。

examples.en: The little boy fussed about eating his vegetables.
examples.zh: 小男孩為了吃蔬菜的事鬧脾氣。

examples.en: The horse began to gallop across the open field.
examples.zh: 馬開始在開闊的原野上疾馳。

examples.en: The children galloped down the hall to the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 孩子們飛奔過走廊，跑向餐廳。

examples.en: Prices galloped upward during the holiday season.
examples.zh: 假期期間，物價急速上漲。

examples.en: The horse broke into a gallop as soon as the gate opened.
examples.zh: 柵門一開，馬就開始飛奔。

examples.en: We heard the gallop of horses behind us.
examples.zh: 我們聽見背後傳來馬匹奔馳的聲音。

examples.en: She rode at a gallop along the beach.
examples.zh: 她沿著海灘策馬疾馳。

examples.en: Each garment in this shop is made by hand.
examples.zh: 這家店的每一件衣服都是手工製作的。

examples.en: Please wash this garment in cold water.
examples.zh: 請用冷水洗這件衣服。

examples.en: The factory produces garments for many famous stores.
examples.zh: 這家工廠為許多知名商店生產服飾。

examples.en: The fuel gauge shows that the tank is almost empty.
examples.zh: 油量表顯示油箱幾乎空了。

examples.en: Check the tire pressure with a gauge before the trip.
examples.zh: 出發旅行前，用壓力計檢查輪胎的氣壓。

examples.en: Test scores are one gauge of a student's progress.
examples.zh: 考試成績是衡量學生進步的一項標準。

examples.en: The teacher asked questions to gauge how much we understood.
examples.zh: 老師提問，以了解我們理解了多少。

examples.en: It is hard to gauge the size of the room from a photo.
examples.zh: 光看照片很難判斷房間有多大。

examples.en: We use this tool to gauge the temperature of the water.
examples.zh: 我們用這項工具測量水溫。

examples.en: Taiwan's geographical position makes it important for trade.
examples.zh: 台灣的地理位置使它在貿易上十分重要。

examples.en: The map shows the geographical features of the island.
examples.zh: 這張地圖顯示了該島的地理特徵。

examples.en: Geographical differences can affect the way people live.
examples.zh: 地理上的差異會影響人們的生活方式。

examples.en: We learned about triangles in today's geometry class.
examples.zh: 我們在今天的幾何課學到了三角形。

examples.en: Geometry helps architects design strong buildings.
examples.zh: 幾何學幫助建築師設計堅固的建築。

examples.en: She got full marks on her geometry test.
examples.zh: 她的幾何考試拿了滿分。

examples.en: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain each year.
examples.zh: 冰河每年都沿著山坡緩緩向下移動。

examples.en: We took a boat trip to see the glacier up close.
examples.zh: 我們搭船近距離欣賞冰河。

examples.en: Warmer weather is causing the glacier to melt.
examples.zh: 天氣變暖使這座冰河逐漸融化。

senses.zh: 迷人的；富有魅力的；光鮮亮麗的

examples.en: She looked glamorous in her long red dress.
examples.zh: 她穿著紅色長禮服，看起來十分迷人。

examples.en: Many people think a movie star's life is glamorous.
examples.zh: 許多人認為電影明星的生活很光鮮亮麗。

examples.en: They stayed at a glamorous hotel by the sea.
examples.zh: 他們住在海邊一家豪華迷人的飯店。

examples.en: The lake gleamed in the morning sunlight.
examples.zh: 湖面在晨光中閃閃發亮。

examples.en: Her new shoes gleamed after she polished them.
examples.zh: 她把新鞋擦亮後，鞋子閃閃發光。

examples.en: The knife gleamed on the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 廚房桌上的刀子閃著光。

examples.en: A gleam of light came through the small window.
examples.zh: 一道微光從小窗戶透了進來。

examples.en: He had a happy gleam in his eyes.
examples.zh: 他的眼中閃著快樂的光芒。

examples.en: The first gleam of dawn appeared over the hills.
examples.zh: 第一道曙光出現在山丘上方。

examples.en: The snow glittered in the bright winter sun.
examples.zh: 積雪在明亮的冬陽下閃閃發光。

examples.en: Stars glittered above the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 星星在寧靜的湖面上方閃爍。

examples.en: Her necklace glittered under the party lights.
examples.zh: 她的項鍊在派對燈光下閃閃發亮。

examples.en: The children decorated the cards with glitter.
examples.zh: 孩子們用亮片裝飾卡片。

examples.en: There was a glitter of excitement in her eyes.
examples.zh: 她的眼裡閃爍著興奮的光芒。

examples.en: The glitter of the city lights amazed the tourists.
examples.zh: 城市燈火的璀璨讓遊客驚嘆不已。

examples.en: The rainy weather filled the room with gloom.
examples.zh: 雨天讓整間房間顯得陰暗。

examples.en: A sense of gloom settled over the team after the loss.
examples.zh: 輸球之後，球隊籠罩著沮喪的氣氛。

examples.en: We walked through the gloom of the old tunnel.
examples.zh: 我們走過舊隧道的幽暗。

examples.en: The goalkeeper jumped high to stop the ball.
examples.zh: 守門員高高躍起擋下了球。

examples.en: Our school's goalkeeper is the tallest player on the team.
examples.zh: 我們學校的守門員是隊上最高的球員。

examples.en: The goalkeeper wears special gloves to catch the ball.
examples.zh: 守門員戴著特殊手套來接球。

examples.en: The two schools exchanged gifts as a sign of goodwill.
examples.zh: 兩所學校互贈禮物，表達友好之意。

examples.en: Free repairs helped the shop build goodwill with customers.
examples.zh: 免費維修幫助這家店贏得顧客的好感。

examples.en: The company's goodwill is worth millions of dollars.
examples.zh: 這家公司的商譽價值數百萬元。

examples.en: The gorilla sat quietly and ate leaves at the zoo.
examples.zh: 大猩猩在動物園裡安靜地坐著吃樹葉。

examples.en: A baby gorilla clung to its mother's back.
examples.zh: 一隻小猩猩緊抱著媽媽的背。

examples.en: We watched a documentary about gorillas in Africa.
examples.zh: 我們看了一部關於非洲大猩猩的紀錄片。

examples.en: The choir sang a beautiful gospel song at the church.
examples.zh: 合唱團在教堂裡唱了一首優美的福音歌曲。

examples.en: Don't take everything online as gospel.
examples.zh: 別把網路上的一切都當成絕對真理。

examples.en: He read a passage from the gospel aloud.
examples.zh: 他大聲朗讀福音書中的一段文字。

examples.en: Sheep graze on the hills near our village.
examples.zh: 綿羊在我們村莊附近的山丘上吃草。

examples.en: He fell off his bike and grazed his knee.
examples.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來，擦傷了膝蓋。

examples.en: The ball grazed the top of the net.
examples.zh: 球擦過了網子的頂端。

examples.en: She had a small graze on her elbow.
examples.zh: 她的手肘上有一處小擦傷。

examples.en: The nurse cleaned the graze with water.
examples.zh: 護理師用清水清洗擦傷處。

examples.en: It is only a graze, so you don't need a bandage.
examples.zh: 只是小擦傷，你不需要包紮。

examples.en: Wash your hands well to remove the grease.
examples.zh: 把手洗乾淨以去除油脂。

examples.en: The cook wiped the grease off the pan.
examples.zh: 廚師把平底鍋上的油脂擦掉。

examples.en: A little grease will stop the door from squeaking.
examples.zh: 抹上一點潤滑油，門就不會嘎吱作響了。

examples.en: Please grease the pan before you bake the cake.
examples.zh: 烤蛋糕之前，請先在烤盤上抹油。

examples.en: He greased the bike chain to make it run smoothly.
examples.zh: 他替腳踏車鏈條上油，讓它運轉順暢。

examples.en: Mom greased the baking tray with butter.
examples.zh: 媽媽用奶油塗抹烤盤。

examples.en: The students groaned when the teacher announced a surprise quiz.
examples.zh: 老師宣布臨時小考時，學生們哀嚎起來。

examples.en: He groaned in pain after twisting his ankle.
examples.zh: 他扭傷腳踝後痛得呻吟。

examples.en: The old floor groaned under our feet.
examples.zh: 老舊的地板在我們腳下嘎吱作響。

examples.en: A loud groan came from the back of the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室後方傳來一聲大大的哀嘆。

examples.en: He let out a groan when he saw the long line.
examples.zh: 他看到長長的隊伍，不禁發出一聲嘆息。

examples.en: We heard a groan from the sick man in the next room.
examples.zh: 我們聽見隔壁房間生病的男子發出呻吟聲。

examples.en: The dog began to growl when a stranger came near.
examples.zh: 陌生人靠近時，狗開始低吼。

examples.en: My stomach growled during the long meeting.
examples.zh: 開長會時，我的肚子咕嚕咕嚕叫。

examples.en: He growled an answer without looking up.
examples.zh: 他頭也不抬，粗聲粗氣地回答。

examples.en: We heard a low growl from behind the bush.
examples.zh: 我們聽見灌木叢後面傳來低沉的吼聲。

examples.en: The tiger's growl scared the children at the zoo.
examples.zh: 老虎的吼聲嚇到了動物園裡的孩子。

examples.en: "Leave me alone," he said with a growl.
examples.zh: 「別管我。」他低聲吼道。

examples.en: Students often grumble about having too much homework.
examples.zh: 學生常常抱怨作業太多。

examples.en: He grumbled all the way to the bus stop.
examples.zh: 他一路嘀嘀咕咕地走到公車站。

examples.en: Stop grumbling and help me clean the kitchen.
examples.zh: 別再抱怨了，來幫我打掃廚房。

examples.en: There were a few grumbles about the new schedule.
examples.zh: 大家對新的時間表發了一些牢騷。

examples.en: He answered with a grumble and went back to work.
examples.zh: 他嘀咕著回答，然後繼續工作。

examples.en: I heard a grumble from the back seat.
examples.zh: 我聽見後座傳來一聲抱怨。

examples.en: A hacker broke into the company's computer system last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有駭客入侵了公司的電腦系統。

examples.en: Use a strong password to protect your account from hackers.
examples.zh: 使用高強度的密碼，以保護你的帳號免受駭客入侵。

examples.en: The school invited a security expert to talk about hackers.
examples.zh: 學校邀請了一位資安專家來談談駭客。

examples.en: The hail damaged the roofs of several cars.
examples.zh: 冰雹打壞了好幾輛車的車頂。

examples.en: We ran inside when the hail started to fall.
examples.zh: 冰雹開始落下時，我們跑進屋裡。

examples.en: Heavy hail ruined the farmers' fruit this year.
examples.zh: 今年的大冰雹毀了農民的水果。

examples.en: It hailed for about ten minutes this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午下了大約十分鐘的冰雹。

examples.en: She raised her hand to hail a taxi.
examples.zh: 她舉起手招了一輛計程車。

examples.en: Critics hailed the film as a great success.
examples.zh: 評論家讚揚這部電影非常成功。

examples.en: Heavy traffic may hamper our trip to the airport.
examples.zh: 嚴重的塞車可能會妨礙我們前往機場。

examples.en: Bad weather hampered the rescue work.
examples.zh: 惡劣的天氣阻礙了救援工作。

examples.en: Loud noise can hamper your ability to study.
examples.zh: 吵雜的噪音會妨礙你讀書。

examples.en: She packed sandwiches and fruit in a picnic hamper.
examples.zh: 她把三明治和水果裝進野餐籃。

examples.en: The laundry hamper is full of dirty clothes.
examples.zh: 洗衣籃裡裝滿了髒衣服。

examples.en: We gave our teacher a gift hamper at the end of the year.
examples.zh: 學年結束時，我們送給老師一個禮物籃。

examples.en: The night market sells beautiful handicrafts made by local artists.
examples.zh: 夜市販售由在地藝術家製作的精美手工藝品。

examples.en: Making handicrafts is a popular class at our school.
examples.zh: 做手工藝是我們學校很受歡迎的課程。

examples.en: She sells her handicrafts online to tourists.
examples.zh: 她在網路上把自己的手工藝品賣給遊客。

examples.en: It is against school rules to harass other students.
examples.zh: 騷擾其他同學違反校規。

examples.en: Reporters harassed the singer outside her home.
examples.zh: 記者在歌手家門外糾纏她。

examples.en: Telemarketers harass me with calls every evening.
examples.zh: 電話行銷人員每天晚上都打電話來煩我。

examples.en: My grandfather plays the harmonica on the porch.
examples.zh: 我爺爺在門廊吹口琴。

examples.en: She bought a small harmonica at the music shop.
examples.zh: 她在樂器行買了一支小口琴。

examples.en: The harmonica is easy to carry on trips.
examples.zh: 口琴很方便旅行時攜帶。

examples.en: The horse wore a leather harness on its back.
examples.zh: 馬的背上套著皮製的馬具。

examples.en: The climber checked her safety harness before going up.
examples.zh: 攀岩者在往上爬之前檢查了她的安全帶。

examples.en: Put the dog in a harness before you go for a walk.
examples.zh: 散步前，先替狗套上胸背帶。

examples.en: The town harnesses wind power to make electricity.
examples.zh: 這座城鎮利用風力發電。

examples.en: Schools can harness technology to help students learn.
examples.zh: 學校可以善用科技來幫助學生學習。

examples.en: They harnessed the river to run a small mill.
examples.zh: 他們利用這條河推動一座小磨坊。

examples.en: People say a ghost haunts the old school building.
examples.zh: 人們說一個鬼魂常在舊校舍裡出沒。

examples.en: The memory of that mistake still haunts him.
examples.zh: 那個錯誤的記憶仍然縈繞在他心頭。

examples.en: The students often haunt the library before exams.
examples.zh: 考試前，學生常常泡在圖書館。

examples.en: This cafe is her favorite haunt after school.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡店是她放學後最愛去的地方。

examples.en: The park is a popular haunt for joggers.
examples.zh: 這座公園是慢跑者常去的地方。

examples.en: The old library became his regular haunt.
examples.zh: 那間老圖書館成了他經常光顧的地方。

examples.en: Eating fresh vegetables is a healthful habit.
examples.zh: 吃新鮮蔬菜是有益健康的習慣。

examples.en: The school offers healthful meals at lunch.
examples.zh: 學校午餐提供有益健康的餐點。

examples.en: A walk in the park is a healthful way to relax.
examples.zh: 在公園散步是有益健康的放鬆方式。

examples.en: We had a hearty breakfast before the long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行前，我們吃了一頓豐盛的早餐。

examples.en: The host gave us a hearty welcome at the door.
examples.zh: 主人在門口熱情地歡迎我們。

examples.en: Please accept my hearty thanks for your help.
examples.zh: 請接受我對你幫忙的由衷感謝。

examples.en: A tall hedge surrounds the garden.
examples.zh: 一道高高的樹籬圍著花園。

examples.en: Dad trims the hedge every spring.
examples.zh: 爸爸每年春天都修剪樹籬。

examples.en: Buying gold can be a hedge against rising prices.
examples.zh: 買黃金可以作為抵禦物價上漲的防範措施。

senses.zh: 含糊其詞；避免正面回答

examples.en: The mayor hedged when reporters asked about the plan.
examples.zh: 記者詢問這項計畫時，市長含糊其詞。

examples.en: Don't hedge; just tell me what you really think.
examples.zh: 別閃爍其詞，直接告訴我你真正的想法。

examples.en: He hedged his answer so he would not upset anyone.
examples.zh: 他回答得很含糊，以免得罪任何人。

examples.en: The scary music heightened the tension in the movie.
examples.zh: 驚悚的音樂加劇了電影中的緊張感。

examples.en: The new rule is meant to heighten safety on campus.
examples.zh: 這項新規定是為了提高校園的安全。

examples.en: Good lighting can heighten the beauty of a room.
examples.zh: 良好的照明可以增添房間的美感。
